Companion vitest unit-test run (41 passed) covers the engine logic for this in Node.

checks.name: highway-pause-during-chase-video-resumes-correctly
checks.evidence: BUG: the full-screen police-chase <div data-testid=highway-chase-video-overlay> (class '...z-[100]...') sits above the game header and intercepts all pointer events, including highway-pause-button. Playwright click (both plain and force:true) on highway-pause-button while the video overlay is visible fails/no-ops with 'subtree intercepts pointer events' (element reported as visible+enabled+stable but the overlay's Skip button receives the hit instead). window.__highway.status stayed 'playing' after the click attempt. The Pause control is therefore unreachable during the film in the UI, contradicting the acceptance criterion that expects Pause to work mid-film and surface a Pause overlay once the film ends.

checks.name: highway-gameover-and-restart-no-chase-carryover
checks.evidence: Forced a mid-chase collision via the obstacles test hook; highway-game-over appeared with no highway-chase-indicator/-banner present; 'Erneut spielen' (highway-restart-button) restarted the round with window.__highway.chase=false and nextChaseAt reset to 20000 (CHASE_FIRST_MS).

bugs.description: During the Polizeijagd cinematic, the full-screen video overlay (z-[100]) covers and intercepts pointer events for the game header, making the Pause button (highway-pause-button) unclickable while the film plays. This contradicts the acceptance criterion requiring Pause to be usable during the film (showing a Pause overlay once the film ends).
bugs.evidence: Browser check 'highway-pause-during-chase-video-resumes-correctly' (see script_path /app/.emergent/scripts/checks/highway-pause-during-chase-video-resumes-correctly.mjs). Playwright error: '<button data-testid="highway-chase-video-skip">...</button> from <div ... data-testid="highway-chase-video-overlay" ...> subtree intercepts pointer events' when attempting a non-forced click on highway-pause-button; forced click also left window.__highway.status==='playing' (unchanged from 'playing', never became 'paused').

action_items: Fix: either raise the Pause button's stacking/pointer-events above the chase video overlay, or add a dedicated pause affordance to the CinematicVideo overlay itself, so players can pause mid-film as specified.
notes: window.__highway dev hook confirmed present only on the Vite dev/preview build as stated in seed_facts; used to force imminent chases and fast-forward elapsed without needing to wait real minutes.
Highway is playable fully as a guest (no login), matching seed_facts; no round-RPC traffic was exercised/needed for these checks.

Browser locale for this environment renders the subtitle in English by default ('The police are chasing you!'); matched against both DE/EN variants per spec_deviations note that the chip/banner title stays English in both locales while the subtitle is translated.
